column1: Blakes Light got diminished today, may Yours not be Diminished either.
column2: 今天布莱克之光黯淡了一分，但愿你的光芒不会同样黯淡。

column1: Clearly the concept of honour is lost to you. If I had a Star available, I would kill you myself for your failure. I suggest you leave before one does become available.
column2: 显然，你早已不懂荣誉为何物。要是我手头有一支星组，我会亲自因你的失败杀了你。趁下一支星组真的出现之前，赶紧离开。

column1: Commander, this outcome is unacceptable. Your conduct and performance failed to meet the Republic's expectations, and such negligence undermines our survival. No payment will be issued, and your reputation here has suffered greatly.
column2: 指挥官，这个结果无法接受。你的行为和表现没有达到共和国的要求，如此疏忽会动摇我们的生存根基。此次任务不会支付报酬，你在这里的声望也已大幅受损。

column1: Commander, your failure reflects poorly on your abilities. The Vesper Marches does not tolerate incompetence, and no payment will be issued for such an inadequate performance.
column2: 指挥官，你的失败暴露了自身能力的不足。维斯珀边区无法容忍无能之辈，这种糟糕的表现不会得到报酬。

column1: Commander, your failure to complete this task has left the Timbuktu Collective vulnerable to further harm. No payment will be issued for this breach of trust.
column2: 指挥官，你没能完成任务，让廷巴克图集体暴露在进一步的伤害之下。辜负我们的信任，自然不会得到报酬。

column1: Commander, your failure to deliver on a simple contract undermines the respect you once held. Understand that no payment will be forthcoming as a result of your failure.
column2: 指挥官，你连一份简单的合约都没能兑现，辜负了我们曾给予你的尊重。明白一点：你的失败不会带来任何报酬。

column1: I have half a mind to enslave you and your company for failing to complete any of the objectives.  Leave my presence before I change my mind.
column2: 你们一个目标都没完成，我真想把你和你的公司都贬为奴隶。趁我改变主意之前，滚出我的视线。

column1: Seriously, how can you expect to be taken seriously as a mercenary if you can't even complete a simple contract?  I hope you don't expect payment, as none will be forthcoming.
column2: 说真的，连一份简单的合约都完成不了，你凭什么让人把你当成佣兵？别指望报酬了，一分都不会有。

column1: That was an utter catastrophe, Commander. We can't afford failures like that.
column2: 那简直是一场彻底的灾难，指挥官。我们承受不起这样的失败。

column1: TODO Bad Faith.
column2: 待定：恶意失败评价。

column1: We have a special place in the polar regions of Lothario for mercenaries who can't complete objectives.  Be thankful that all I am doing is not paying you!
column2: 洛萨里奥的极地专门为完不成目标的佣兵准备了一个特殊去处。好好庆幸吧，我现在只是不给你报酬！

column1: Your cowardice is as much as I expect from a mercenary. Your lack of honour deserves far more than a lack of payment.
column2: 佣兵的怯懦，我早就料到了。你毫无荣誉可言，配得上的惩罚远不止不给报酬。

column1: Your cowardice is as much as I expect from mercenary scum.  We have nothing further to discuss, unless you wish to make yourself my bondsman as payment for your failing!
column2: 佣兵败类的怯懦，我早有预料。我们没什么好谈的——除非你愿意卖身为奴，拿自己抵偿这次失败！

column1: Your cowardice is typical of a mercenary.  Leave now, before I kill you myself for your dishonor.
column2: 佣兵的怯懦果然名不虚传。现在就滚，在我因你的无耻亲手杀了你之前。

column1: Your cowardice justifies your commoner status.  If you cannot even fulfill a simple contract, perhaps you should stop meddling in our affairs and find work far away from here.
column2: 你的怯懦证明你只配做个平民。连简单的合约都履行不了，就别再插手我们的事务，去远处另谋生路吧。

column1: Your failure is unacceptable and hinders the progress of the Wolf Empire. No payment will be issued for this inadequacy.
column2: 你的失败不可接受，拖累了狼帝国的进展。如此无能的表现不会得到报酬。

column1: Your performance was appalling, Commander. Your efforts on the battlefield were no better than a group of green cadets, and not indicative of the leader of a reknowned mercenary company.
column2: 你的表现糟糕透顶，指挥官。你在战场上的表现还不如一群新兵，完全配不上知名佣兵公司的领袖之名。

column1: Your performance was appalling, Commander. Your tactics on the battlefield were pathetic and ineffectual.
column2: 你的表现糟糕透顶，指挥官。你在战场上的战术既可悲又毫无成效。

column1: Commander, if you were a Legionnaire I would have you flogged for your incompetence.  However, the contract stipulates partial payment for partial completion, so it has been done.
column2: 指挥官，要是你是军团士兵，我早就因你的无能把你鞭打一顿了。不过合约规定完成一部分就支付一部分，所以这次给你部分报酬。

column1: Commander, the mission objectives were not fully achieved, but your effort and discipline were evident. The Republic recognizes honest failure in difficult circumstances, and partial payment will be issued accordingly.
column2: 指挥官，任务目标没有全部完成，但你的努力与纪律性有目共睹。共和国承认你在艰难处境下的诚实失误，将按规定支付部分报酬。

column1: Commander, we really required the primary objective to be completed, but I suppose I can provide a partial payment for what you did achieve.
column2: 指挥官，我们确实要求你完成主要目标，但看在你已经完成部分任务的份上，我可以支付部分报酬。

column1: Commander, we required the primary objective completed.  However, seeing as you did at least make an attempt, I will forward a partial payment to your account
column2: 指挥官，我们要求你完成主要目标。不过既然你至少做过尝试，我会把部分报酬汇入你的账户。

column1: Commander, while the contract's main objectives were not fully met, your attempts are appreciated. However, our limited resources only allow for partial payment for partial completion.
column2: 指挥官，虽然合约的主要目标没有全部达成，但你的努力值得肯定。不过我们的资源有限，只能按完成程度支付部分报酬。

column1: Commander, while the primary objective was not completed, your efforts have not gone unnoticed. A partial payment will be sent to your account in recognition of your attempt.
column2: 指挥官，虽然主要目标未能完成，但你的努力并没有被忽视。为认可你的尝试，我们会把部分报酬汇入你的账户。

column1: I should never have entrusted such a trivial task to an incompetent mercenary!  It is only my honour that compels me to provide this partial payment for failing to complete all the tasks asked.
column2: 我真不该把这么简单的任务交给无能的佣兵！若不是荣誉所迫，我连这点部分报酬都不会给——你根本没完成交代的全部任务。

column1: I should never have entrusted such a trivial task to one so incompetent!  However I will provide a partial payment for your partial completion, so long as you do better next time.
column2: 我真不该把这么简单的任务交给如此无能之人！不过你至少完成了一部分，我会支付部分报酬；下次给我表现好点。

column1: I should not have expected a mere mercenary to perform as a trueborn warrior.  However, you did partially complete the tasks assigned, so under the terms of the bathcall I am honour bound to provide a partial payment.
column2: 我本就不该指望一个佣兵能有真生战士的表现。不过你确实完成了部分任务，按照挑战战条款，我必须出于荣誉支付部分报酬。

column1: May Blake grant you Wisdom to learn from your mistakes.
column2: 愿布莱克赐你智慧，让你从错误中吸取教训。

column1: The 331st understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will do better for the next battle.
column2: 第 331 团明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你奋勇作战，却没能取得成效。希望你下一场战斗能表现得更好。

column1: The Caliphate rewards loyal commanders.  You have shown merit, but still failed in acheiving all objectives. We trust you will see things our way next time.
column2: 哈里发国奖赏忠诚的指挥官。你展现了应有的能力，却仍未完成全部目标。希望下次你能按我们的要求行事。

column1: The Terran Hegemony understands that sacrifice on the battlefield doesn't always translate to victory. You've made a valiant, yet ineffective effort. We trust you will do better for the next battle.
column2: 泰拉霸权明白，战场上的牺牲并不总能换来胜利。你奋勇作战，却没能取得成效。希望你下一场战斗能表现得更好。

column1: The Wolf Empire values complete success, yet we acknowledge your efforts. A partial payment has been transferred for your partial completion.
column2: 狼帝国重视彻底的胜利，但我们认可你的努力。你完成了部分任务，部分报酬已汇入账户。

column1: TODO Good Faith.
column2: 待定：善意失败评价。

column1: We expect all tasks assigned to be completed, mercenary. However, we recognize your attempt, and provide a partial payment for your partial completion of the tasks.
column2: 佣兵，我们要求你完成交办的全部任务。不过我们认可你的尝试，会按完成程度支付部分报酬。

column1: We expect all tasks assigned to be completed. However, we recognize your attempt, and provide a partial payment for your partial completion of the tasks.
column2: 我们要求你完成交办的全部任务。不过我们认可你的尝试，会按完成程度支付部分报酬。

column1: While you failed to complete the primary objective, the Vesper Marches acknowledges the effort you made. Partial payment has been issued, but know that Duke Brewer values results above all.
column2: 虽然你没能完成主要目标，但维斯珀边区认可你付出的努力。部分报酬已经发放，不过记住，布鲁尔公爵把结果看得高于一切。

column1: You win some, you lose some. Sometimes it's in between. I'm disappointed we couldn't complete the contract, but at least we gave it our best shot.
column2: 有输有赢，也有不上不下的时候。这次没能完成合约确实令人失望，但至少我们已经尽了全力。

column1: You'd never make it in the Tortuga Dominions with that sort of cowardly attitude!  I'll partially pay you this time, but complete the damn contract next time, or else!
column2: 凭你这副怯懦样，根本不可能在托图加领混出头！这次我给你部分报酬，但下次给我把该死的合约完成，否则后果自负！

column1: Commander, you have completed the objectives required, and have our thanks.  Payment is being transferred to your account now.
column2: 指挥官，你已经完成了要求的目标，感谢你的付出。报酬现在就会汇入你的账户。

column1: Excellent work, Commander. The Vesper Marches recognizes your success, and your payment has already been transferred. We look forward to your continued service.
column2: 干得漂亮，指挥官。维斯珀边区认可你的成功，报酬已经汇入账户。期待你继续为我们效力。

column1: I am pleasantly surprised that you completed all the tasks assigned to you.  Know that the Steel Vipers recognize your service, and I have transferred the agreed payment to your account.
column2: 你完成了交办的全部任务，着实让我惊喜。钢铁毒蛇认可你的服务，约定的报酬已经汇入你的账户。

column1: Impressive work, Commander. The Wolf Empire commends your success and has transferred the agreed payment to your account.
column2: 表现出色，指挥官。狼帝国赞许你的成功，约定的报酬已经汇入你的账户。

column1: In Blakes Name you have done Well, Seeker.
column2: 以布莱克之名，你做得很好，探索者。

column1: Outstanding work, Commander! Your efforts have reinforced the Galatean League's position and proven your worth. You can be sure this success won't go unnoticed in future contract negotiations.
column2: 出色的表现，指挥官！你的努力巩固了加拉泰亚联盟的地位，也证明了你的价值。这次成功一定会在今后的合约谈判中得到体现。

column1: Thank you, Commander. Your efforts have safeguarded our people and secured our independence. Payment has been transferred to your account as agreed.
column2: 谢谢你，指挥官。你的努力保护了我们的人民，捍卫了我们的独立。约定的报酬已经汇入你的账户。

column1: TODO Mission Success.
column2: 待定：任务成功评价。

column1: Well done Commander.  The satisfactory completion of this batchall will benefit us both, and I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得不错，指挥官。令人满意地完成这场挑战战对我们双方都有好处，约定的 C-bills 已经汇入你的账户。

column1: Well done Commander.  You have completed the required objectives, and I am happy to remit the full contracted amount to your account.
column2: 干得不错，指挥官。你已经完成了要求的目标，我很乐意把合约全额报酬汇入你的账户。

column1: Well done Commander.  You unwavering loyalty protecting Caliphate ideals is impressive. I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 干得不错，指挥官。你为哈里发国理想而战的坚定忠诚令人印象深刻，约定的 C-bills 已经汇入你的账户。

column1: Well done matey!  You finished off that contract easily, and your share of the loot is already in your account.
column2: 干得漂亮，伙计！你轻松完成了那份合约，属于你的战利品分成已经到账。

column1: Well done, Commander. You made the best of a bad situation. Here's hoping we don't run into another job like that one.
column2: 干得不错，指挥官。你在糟糕的局面下已经做到最好了。希望我们别再遇到这种任务。

column1: Well done, Commander. Your actions have directly strengthened the security and legitimacy of the Tikonov Free Republic. Payment has been authorized, and your standing with us has improved considerably.
column2: 干得不错，指挥官。你的行动直接加强了季科诺夫自由共和国的安全与合法性。报酬已经获批，你在我们这里的地位也大幅提升。

column1: Well done, Commander. Your success furthers the Tamar Pact's vision. I am pleased to fulfill the contract's terms and ensure the full amount is transferred to your account.
column2: 干得不错，指挥官。你的成功推进了塔玛尔协约的愿景。我很高兴履行合约条款，把全额报酬汇入你的账户。

column1: You have completed the objectives required, and have our thanks.  Payment is being transferred to your account now.
column2: 你已经完成了要求的目标，感谢你的付出。报酬现在就会汇入你的账户。

column1: You have succeeded Commander.  The completion of this batchall pleases me, and I have transferred your c-bills as agreed.
column2: 你成功了，指挥官。完成这场挑战战让我很满意，约定的 C-bills 已经汇入你的账户。
